lines.japanese: 「あるもん！」
lines.english: “It does so exist!”

lines.japanese: 「山科？」
lines.english: “Yamashina?”

lines.japanese: 「山科さん……」
lines.english: “Yamashina...”

lines.japanese: 僕の意識が薄れそうになったとき、恋人の顔が目に浮かんだ。まさか、こんなところに山科さんが……。
lines.english: Just as my awareness began to fade, my girlfriend's face appeared before me. Surely Yamashina could not be here, of all places...

lines.japanese: 「羽田君の妄想なら、私が全部受けとめてあげるもん！」
lines.english: “If it’s your delusion, Haneda, I’ll accept every bit of it!”

lines.japanese: 本物だった。僕の幻想じゃなくて、本物の山科さんだ。
lines.english: She was real. Not a vision of mine—the real Yamashina.

lines.japanese: 「妄想とか言わない」
lines.english: “Don't call it a delusion.”

lines.japanese: 「さっきから聞いてれば、勝手なことばかり言って！」
lines.english: “I've been listening to you say whatever you please!”

lines.japanese: 「ひとの話を盗み聞きしない」
lines.english: “Don't eavesdrop on other people's conversations.”

lines.japanese: 「どうしてひとのものを勝手に盗ろうとするの！」
lines.english: “What gives you the right to steal what belongs to someone else?!”

lines.japanese: 「なに言ってるの山科」
lines.english: “What are you talking about, Yamashina?”

lines.japanese: 「横から入り込んできたのはそっちなんだけどなあ」
lines.english: “You’re the one who butted in from the sidelines.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなの関係ないもん！　羽田君は私のことを好きだって言ってくれたんだから、私が一番最初なの！」
lines.english: “That doesn't matter! Haneda told me he loves me, so I was first!”

lines.japanese: 「でも、彼女がいるってことになってたよね。相手がいるオトコに手を出すってどうなの」
lines.english: “But he was supposed to have a girlfriend already, wasn't he? What do you call making a move on a man who's taken?”

lines.japanese: 「仮面彼氏でしょ」
lines.english: “He was only a pretend boyfriend, right?”

lines.japanese: 「うんまあ、それは否定しない」
lines.english: “Well, yes. I won't deny that.”

lines.japanese: 「だけど、こっちは一年生の時から目を付けてたのに、今さらシャシャられても困るよね」
lines.english: “But I've had my eye on him since our first year. You can't come barging in now and expect me to be happy about it.”

lines.japanese: 「関係ないもん！　羽田君は私のことが好きなんだもん！」
lines.english: “That doesn't matter! Haneda loves me!”

lines.japanese: 「ていうか山科、不法侵入」
lines.english: “Also, Yamashina? Breaking and entering.”

lines.japanese: 「鍵は開いてたよ」
lines.english: “The door was unlocked.”

lines.japanese: 「え、鍵が開いてたら入っていいの」
lines.english: “What, an unlocked door means you can come inside?”

lines.japanese: 「いいに決まってるでしょ！」
lines.english: “Of course it does!”

lines.japanese: 「おいおい」
lines.english: “Oh, come on.”

lines.japanese: 「それより真面目に話をしなよ！　する気ないの！？」
lines.english: “Can we talk seriously about this?! Do you even want to?!”

lines.japanese: 「うん、真面目に警察呼ぼうか考えてる」
lines.english: “Mm-hm. I'm seriously considering calling the police.”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君に手を出さなければいいだけの話でしょ？　そんなに羽田君のことが好きなの？」
lines.english: “All you have to do is keep your hands off Haneda! Do you like him that much?”

lines.japanese: 「これから大事な話をしようとしてたの。とりあえず一度、お引き取りいただけないかな」
lines.english: “I was just about to discuss something important with him. Might I ask you to leave for the moment?”

lines.japanese: 「その代わり、羽田君は連れて帰るけどいいよね」
lines.english: “Then I'll be taking Haneda home with me. That's fine, right?”

lines.japanese: 「私も羽田君と話があるんだ。だから連れて帰られちゃうと困るかなあ」
lines.english: “I have something to discuss with Haneda too. So I'd rather you didn't carry him off just yet.”

lines.japanese: ああ、やめて……二人とも争わないで……。
lines.english: Oh, please stop... Don't fight, you two...

lines.japanese: そう言いたかったけど、僕の意識は自分の中に落ちていくことを望んだ。この世界から音が遠ざかっていく。
lines.english: That was what I wanted to say. But my consciousness longed to fall inward, and the sounds of this world receded into the distance.
